title: Command bus command envelope
description: The frame a client sends to start one command (docs/spec/command-bus.md section 1.1). Same shape on every transport. `origin`, `userId` and `deviceId` are set by the host from the authenticated session; a value in the frame is ignored (and counted as a mismatch), never trusted. `args` is typed per kind by schema/bus/registry.json (kinds.<kind>.args): ids and enums, never a path, a shell command or a provider key.

v.description: Contract version. An unknown value is refused unsupported_version.

kind.description: A key of registry.kinds; unknown is refused unknown_kind.

idem.description: Idempotency key: the same (user, idem) with the same kind and args returns the original command, never a second execution.

createdAt.description: Client clock in ms, advisory only.

ttlMs.description: How long the desktop may still start this command after receipt; the receiver enforces its own maximum.
